name: Brahmabit AI Photo Prompt for WooCommerce
author: Brahmabit.ro

sections.description:
Brahmabit Photo Prompt adds a floating AI Photo Generator panel to your WordPress/WooCommerce site. Authorised users (administrators, editors, shop managers) can:

  • Browse, search and filter all WooCommerce products
  • Click Generate Photo on any product
  • The product image is automatically copied to clipboard
  • ChatGPT opens in a new tab with a fully customisable prompt pre-filled
  • Paste the image (Ctrl+V / ⌘V) into the ChatGPT chat and send — done!

Features

  • Accessible from the frontend navigation menu and/or the WP Admin Bar
  • Dedicated admin page under Brahmabit Photo Prompt → Photo Generator
  • Grid and list view for the product browser
  • Paginated product browser (configurable products per page)
  • Fully customisable prompt template with {{product_name}}, {{category}}, {{description}}, {{sku}}, {{price}} placeholders
  • Role-based access control — choose which user roles can see the panel
  • Clean settings page with no impact on store performance

Who is this for?

Store owners, social media managers and marketing teams who want to quickly generate high-quality AI product photos for social media posts without leaving WordPress.

Upgrade to Pro

Brahmabit Photo Prompt is the free starting point. When you’re ready to put your social media on autopilot, upgrade to Social Bit PRO.

Social Bit PRO is a fully automated social media machine — content generation, scheduling, multi-channel publishing, AI strategy, and analytics, all running without manual prompting or copy-pasting.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect any personal data, send data to external servers, or set any tracking cookies. The only external interaction is a browser-initiated navigation to chatgpt.com when the user clicks the Generate Photo button — see the External Services section below.

External Services

This plugin facilitates (but does not automate) opening ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com) in a new browser tab. This happens only when a logged-in, authorised user explicitly clicks the Generate Photo button. No data is sent automatically or in the background.

  • Service: ChatGPT by OpenAI — https://chatgpt.com
  • Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Terms of use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

The product image is copied to the user’s local clipboard using the browser’s Clipboard API. No image data leaves the user’s browser except through the user’s own actions in ChatGPT.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the socialbit-light folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. WooCommerce must be active — the plugin will display an admin notice if it is not
  4. Go to Brahmabit Photo Prompt → Settings to configure the prompt template, role access, and display options
sections.faq:
I don’t see the button in my frontend navigation menu.

Go to Brahmabit Photo Prompt → Settings and verify “Show in Navigation Menu” is enabled. Also make sure your primary navigation menu is assigned to a theme location named primary, main-menu, primary-menu, or header-menu. You can add additional locations via the sbl_menu_locations filter.

The product image is not copying to clipboard.

The Clipboard API requires a secure context (HTTPS). On HTTP sites the plugin falls back to copying the image URL as text instead. Upgrading your site to HTTPS will enable full clipboard functionality.

Can I change the ChatGPT prompt?

Yes — edit the prompt template under Brahmabit Photo Prompt → Settings. Use {{product_name}}, {{category}}, {{description}}, {{sku}} and {{price}} as dynamic placeholders.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Is my data sent anywhere?

No data is sent to any external server by this plugin. When you click “Generate Photo”, your browser opens ChatGPT in a new tab — this is a standard browser navigation action, no different from clicking any external link.
